risk_note: RV2 settlement (settlement-plan B2-04n; BR-FUND-04 ③④⑤⑨⑫, BR-FUND-18; decisions 44, 46). Bill-day job createBillJob in settlement/bill: waits until the ledger snapshot read port says the day is complete or timed out; bill month and range, per-order classification and order_key batch split via packages/domain; recon diffs through ledger registerReconDiff (idempotent); DRAFT batches only through the generated settle-batch transition(); bill summary columns per BR-FUND-05 (beneficiary total includes forfeited and deferred shares, platform retention excludes them, decision 44); open beneficiary obligations become supplement items only in their order's platform batch; credit.enabled off keeps the checks without batches. settle_jobs is idempotent on (app_id, job, platform, run_at) and its status changes only through the generated settle-job transition() with CAS (START / COMPLETE / FAIL / RETRY on the same row, decision 46), writing only the settle_jobs columns granted by migration 0066 (RETRY keeps the first started_at). Not wired into scheduling (B2-04zb).
